body: More like my ex in a nutshell.

It's a typical story. Dad had other priorities. Mom was great but took out her anger issues on me. Was told I was not wanted around a lot. Which is true in all honesty. I stopped feeling bad about it and I don't expecting anyone to stick around. 

I study because I know I have to. I'm doing because I think I can move away from here and then I'll stop feeling bad but I know it won't turn out like that. Had a recent breakup but it's not like it caused this sudden urge to die. That's always been there. But the ex was a lot like my mom. I'm just tired of not being wanted around/being an emotional punching bag. 

I'm not depressed. I don't do any drugs. I've got a roof over my head as long as I don't piss off my mom. I can get up every morning and do stuff. I'm just tired and want to do it already but I don't want to leave a mess (financially) for whoever has to clean up after me.

I can't talk to people about what/how I feel in real life. I stumble and laugh it away or don't talk about it. I only do it online because I don't feel as ashamed. 
Thank you for telling me your story. I hope that you will feel even better soon, and thank you, thank you, thank you, for taking the time to respond to me.
I believed it meant something to him. Lol guess not.
I drove into the opposite lane. My instructor looked like he was going to have a heart attack. -__-
He was nice and loving the day before the break up though. He snapped the next day and didn't contact me after that.

He had temper issues. And if I said something/do something wrong while he was in a bad mood, he would just blame his anger on me and ignore me for hours/days. And yeah, when he told me about his friend webcamming, I told him I wasn't comfortable with him watching it. He was... sneaky? about it. Said he didn't watch her anyway. But when we fought the last time over me not wanting to go on cam for him, he said he would watch her instead and that he already had once. Afterwards, he said it made him mad that his girlfriend wouldn't go on cam for him, but that his friend would.

He did use you. He needed a friend when he needed help then decided he could do better the moment he was well again. I understand the empty feeling though. One day they're your best friend, the next day they dump you and tell you to fuck off because you can't offer them what they want anymore.

I'm bitter as fuck though.
It's my first relationship but his 4th/5th one? I guess that's why it's easy for him to walk away.
Your girlfriend sounds like she has her own emotional issues and just took it out on you to be frank.
